messages:
Marta G: Quick sync — we need to lock the SI onboarding cadence for the new cloud marketplace + HW partner bundle. Goal: first cohort certified before Q3 launch. Thoughts?
Sam E: Love it. Can we do 2-week cohorts? onboarding + hands-on lab + certification exam.
Ravi P: 2 weeks sounds tight if we include hardware provisioning. Need a buffer for device shipping.
Ana L: HW partner can do regional lab drops (US/EU) but lead time ~3 weeks. Could do a lab loaner pool for pilot.
Theo C: From product side we want a checklist: core Redwood API, Dedicated deploy, VPC private runbook. Can we split the curriculum into modules?
Marta G: Proposed modules: 1) Redwood fundamentals (API/console) 2) Dedicated ops (capacity + SLAs) 3) Private/VPC install 4) HW integration + troubleshooting 5) Marketplace listing + joint announcement prep
Sam E: For certs: practical eval + short written. Pass = access to partner badge and co-sell enablement.
Ravi P: Practical eval needs 2 scenarios: cold-start latency debug, and model rollback/fallback config. Approx 45m each.
Ana L: HW partner wants a runbook section on firmware/driver matrix + troubleshooting steps. They can supply a 1-page cheat sheet.
Theo C: Also include an automated smoke test we can run post-install. I'll add a Jenkins job skeleton:```
#!/bin/bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping || exit 1
# run small generation and check tokens
```
Ravi P: Love the smoke test. We should also record a short walkthrough video for the lab flow.
Marta G: Ok action items: Sam build curriculum draft, Ravi define practical scenarios + scoring rubric, Ana coordinate HW loaners and cheat sheet, Theo add smoke test + marketplace listing checklist.
Sam E: I'll draft a 10-day pilot plan: 3 days self-study, 4 days lab + mentor hours, day 8 exam, day 10 wrap + feedback.
Ana L: I'll confirm loaner inventory by next Wed and drop shipping SLA to partners.
Ravi P: Who owns the certification platform? We can use our LMS or a lightweight proctoring form.
Marta G: Use LMS for written; proctored practical via shared screen session. Ops-bot: created task #P-4821 for cohort planning :white_check_mark:
LegalBot: Reminder — need partner MSA addendum for co-marketing and marketplace listing. Tagging Legal for review.
Theo C: I'll prep the marketplace assets (logo, description, integrations matrix). Need final partner logo by EOD Mon.
Sam E: Volunteers for pilot mentors? @Ravi P, @Ana L?
Ravi P: I can mentor one session a week.
Ana L: I can do 2 sessions and a hardware troubleshooting office hour.
Marta G: Great — tentative dates: pilot cohort 1 start 2025-05-12. If HW shipping takes 3 weeks, we need partner sign-off by 2025-04-14.
Theo C: Marking calendar. Can we aim for a public joint blog + marketplace listing in the week after certification?
Marta G: Yes — plan for soft launch to marketplace, then larger joint announcement after first two cohorts.
Sam E: I'll share the curriculum doc in #partnerships tomorrow morning. Feedback requested by Friday. :thumbsup:
Marta G: Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates.
ops-bot: task P-4821 updated: assignees Sam E, Ravi P, Ana L, Theo C. Due 2025-04-14.
